annotation.title_en: Chair's Statement of the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference & High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China
annotation.venue: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the PRC website
annotation.summary_en: Chair's statement from the 2026 World AI Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance in Shanghai. It sets out fifteen points on innovation, openness, data, sustainability, employment, security, AI agents, UN-centred multilateralism, standards and capacity-building, and announces the signing of the agreement establishing the World AI Cooperation Organization (WAICO).
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for risk-oriented, agile, tiered and category-based AI management, keeping AI under human control
AI agents must have defined decision authority, behavioral boundaries, and tracing and risk-alert mechanisms
Supports the UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance and the Independent International Scientific Panel on AI
Urges faster formulation of security, industrial and ethical standards, with mutual recognition among countries
Announces signing of the agreement establishing WAICO, headquartered in Shanghai, to support Global South AI capacity
